channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
item.description: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.

item.title: Potential Taiwan tension sparked 'last minute' change in Trump-Xi National Archives visit
item.description: The sudden change was precipitated because of Chinese displeasure over one document that the U.S. had planned to show.

item.title: Trump weakens fuel efficiency standards. And, Cornell fraternity rape case reopened
item.description: The Trump administration has weakened fuel efficiency standards for new cars. And, prosecutors have reopened a Cornell University fraternity rape case.

item.title: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
item.description: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

item.title: Utah man released after decades on death row as DNA evidence excludes him from 1985 killing
item.description: A Utah man who spent decades on death row was released on bail after DNA evidence excluded him from the 1985 killing of a police chief's aunt.

item.title: Venezuelan national shot by ICE officer in Austin charged with assaulting federal officer
item.description: The Justice Department charged Wilber Rafael Garces-Perez with assaulting a federal officer after an Austin vehicle pursuit ended in an ICE shooting.

item.title: Cam Schlittler and Ben Rice, Yankees’ own Massachusetts natives, crush Red Sox in Game 1 blowout
item.description: Cam Schlittler struck out 10 in 6.1 scoreless innings and Ben Rice launched a grand slam as the New York Yankees routed Boston without Aaron Judge.

item.title: Sylvester Stallone's advice to those who are struggling 50 years after 'Rocky' changed his life
item.description: Sylvester Stallone, now 80, shares the motto he lives by and why he wrote "The Steps" so his children could understand his journey from obscurity.

item.title: Immigrant shot by ICE in Austin is charged with assault
item.description: An affidavit unsealed Tuesday said the officer who shot Wilber Garcés Pérez was not wearing a body camera and another officer had turned his camera off.

item.title: Hegseth bars military academies from hiring civilians as tenured professors
item.description: The move marks the latest effort by the Trump administration to exert more control over faculty at service academies.

item.title: Supreme Court allows ‘third country’ deportations to resume for now
item.description: The high court will later hear arguments and make a final ruling on the Trump administration’s controversial policy of sending migrants to countries where they are not citizens.

item.title: Jack Smith clashes with senators over Trump probes, says he will not be silenced
item.description: Jack Smith returned to Capitol Hill on Tuesday to defend his derailed efforts to prosecute President Donald Trump, telling lawmakers he would not “be silenced by continued threats of prosecution” from the president.

item.title: Hawaii’s wicked run of hurricanes is a preview of what El Niño has in store
item.description: Three hurricanes in the past month have given the state a taste of what a record-setting El Niño will bring to many this year.

item.title: Trump says new fuel economy rules will cut car prices. Analysts are doubtful.
item.description: In rolling back fuel efficiency standards, the administration said the average new vehicle price in 2031 should be reduced by $1,300.

item.title: Education Department officially scraps Biden-era Title IX rules
item.description: The new regulations mark a return to rules from the first Trump administration.

item.title: Want advice on financing college? Sign up for the Paying for College 101 Newsletter.
item.description: In this six-part guide, reporter Danielle Douglas-Gabriel helps you navigate the complex maze of paying for higher education.

item.title: At every turn, Trump’s ideas for aiding U.S. consumers run into resistance
item.description: From beef to diesel, White House efforts to bring down prices — the top concern among midterm voters — have failed so far to pan out.

item.title: Appeals court signals support for contempt inquiry on deportation flights
item.description: Judge James E. Boasberg started the inquiry after Trump officials did not abide by his orders in 2025 to turn back planes carrying Venezuelan migrants.

item.title: Republican blocks Senate resolution criticizing Trump’s taxpayer-funded ads
item.description: Sen. Cynthia Lummis (R-Wyoming) argued that past presidents in both parties have aired similar announcements.

item.title: Officials cast doubt on Trump’s plan for drones, snipers at proposed arch
item.description: The arch is still envisioned to be a tourist site, despite the president’s announcement that it would be a “military complex,” administration officials told advocacy groups.
